name: Taizhou Museum
objection: Local city museum; only one counted source and 621 views.

name: Taizhou Ocean World
objection: Operator-style commercial aquarium, generic content; unverified current opening.

name: Taizhou Fonte Wild Mainland
objection: Chain operator park; one counted source; Wikivoyage text reads like marketing copy.

name: Taizhou Confucian Temple
objection: For: a historic temple complex beside the Fucheng wall area that visitors walk to. Against: no counted See listing, may be part of the Fucheng zone.

name: Jiufeng Mountain
objection: One counted source only; local hill for Huangyan residents.

name: China Citrus Expo Park
objection: For: permanent themed park with a visitor exhibition. Against: farm-style park, one official feature, rural.

name: Linghu Park
objection: For: guide-named lakeside stop. Against: ordinary city park, which COVERAGE rejects as a suburban park.

name: Wenling Changyu Dongtian
objection: Two sources but few English views; remote from other stops.

name: Qiongtai Xian Valley

name: Kuocang Mountain

name: Dachen Islands
objection: Ferry-reached; the island group is an area, not one spot.

name: Yijiangshan Island
objection: For: historic site next to Dachen. Against: access and public opening unclear; coordinates (28.608,121.8135) look plausible for the island.

name: Dongji Islands
objection: Remote, boat-only; only government-tourism sources found.

name: Tiantai Mountain
objection: Large area rather than one point; pin needs a visitor point.

name: Guoqing Temple
objection: Temple judged for interior: the complex and its Sui-era pagoda are the draw.

name: Fangguang Temple
objection: For: significant temple in the scenic area. Against: part of Tiantai Mountain and a single thin source.

name: Gaoming Temple
objection: For: historic Tiantai temple near Guoqing. Against: nothing in visitor sources describes it.

name: Huading Mountain
objection: For: a named summit with views. Against: part of Tiantai Mountain scenic area and festival-linked.

name: Xianju National Park
objection: The 'national park' name is the scenic area; best name is Shenxianju.

name: Taoqi Ancient City
objection: Remote, 50 km east of Linhai; 'Taoqi' in the file is a misspelling.

name: East Lake, Linhai
objection: For: lake and old streets are distinct from the wall. Against: part of the Fucheng cultural tourism zone.

name: Linhai Museum
objection: For: free, guide-listed. Against: a local museum with 0 views.

name: Pu'an Lighthouse
objection: For: coastal landmark photo stop. Against: short stop, effectively part of Dongsha Fishing Village.

name: Dalu Island
objection: Boat-only access; ferry timing.

name: Jishan Island
objection: For: ferry-served island day out. Against: one source, thin detail.

name: Xuanmen Bay National Wetland Park

objection: For: 4A, paid attraction. Against: farm-picking park, overlaps the wetland park.

name: Longxi Animation Flower Valley
objection: For: permanent family attraction. Against: commercial kids' park, thin source.

name: Dongsha Fishing Village
objection: One source only; its hours text looks copied.

name: Baima Ao Beach
objection: Small beach (200 m), one source.

name: Shitang Peninsula (Shitang Fishing Village)
objection: Several villages make up the area; pin needs a visitor point.

name: Sansuan Island
objection: For: second-tier island a tourism board names. Against: one counted source, boat-only, thin detail.

name: Shepan Island
objection: Remote with ferry; few visitors.

name: Ziyang Old Street
objection: Inside the Fucheng wall zone, so a close neighbour of the wall entry.

name: Jinshan Park

name: Wu Zixiong Glass Art Museum
objection: Niche single-artist museum.
